text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said he has summoned Rural Development Minister Annuar Musa for a meeting on Monday to discuss allegations that 600 million ringgit was missing from the Risda Replanting Fund.

-- New Malacca chief minister Abu Zahar Isnin said the arrest of a state asemblyman on Saturday by Anti-Corruption Agency as indicating the government was serious in creating a clean, trustworthy image.
-- Bank Islam has received shareholders' approval over a proposal to restructure the company.
